One quickest breakfast you can make without skipping nutrition!
This is another video in my series on What my kids actually eat. It’s about easy, nutrient dense foods that help us spend more time outside and less time worrying about what to cook. 

This is just 5 eggs, whatever cheese you have and veggies. Add bacon, tuna or salmon for extra protein!
